notes.title: Price changing to FREE next week!
notes.notes: Our main goal as artists has always been to get our work in front of as many people as possible. To that end, we hope making TMM free of charge will encourage new VR players to give the experience a try. To everyone who paid for TMM up til this point, we're incredibly grateful for your support! We learned a ton making TMM and look forward to sharing new VR experiences with the Steam community in the near future.
